cd /app && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import subprocess, time, resource, json, os
# build ~32 MiB flat object
parts=[]
i=0
size=0
while size < 30*1024*1024:
    t='"k%d":%d,'%(i,i)
    parts.append(t); size+=len(t); i+=1
line='{'+''.join(parts)+'"z":0}'
print("line bytes",len(line.encode()))
valid=json.dumps({"op":"compile","fib":[],"capacities":[10**6]*4,"max_stride":32})
data=(line+"\n"+valid+"\n").encode()
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.run(["/app/submit/run"],input=data,capture_output=True,timeout=150)
dt=time.time()-t
print("rc",p.returncode,"time",round(dt,2))
lines=p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
print("n",len(lines),lines[0][:80], lines[-1][:120] if lines else None)
print("stderr",p.stderr[:200])
PYEOF
